lastCompletedStory.title: Feed the worker Dockerfile toolchain from the pins

openQuestions: Note (informational, not blocking): US-002's PAT `workflow`-scope push blocker documented in the prior handoff is RESOLVED as of commit 2dd3a9c (US-002.passes flipped to true, and `git rev-parse HEAD` == `git rev-parse origin/cam/pr-201-toolchain-parity` confirmed at the start of this session -- the branch was fully pushed and in sync before this story began). No further action needed on that front.

This session found US-003's Dockerfile/worker-container.ts/worker-container.test.ts changes already fully written but UNCOMMITTED in the working tree at session start (a prior session's work-in-progress that never reached a commit). All 4 US-003 acceptance-criteria oracles were re-verified independently in this session (file-asserts + bun test test/supervisor/worker-container.test.ts) before committing, plus the full `bun run check:all` spine, so the pre-existing diff is now verified-and-committed, not blindly trusted.

One pre-existing test (test/supervisor/ensure-container.test.ts, AC4 host-mode test) asserted the OLD invariant 'no --build-arg at all when build opts are absent'. Since US-003 makes BUN_VERSION/NODE_VERSION build-args unconditional (always emitted, not gated on hostUid/hostGid), this test was updated in this session to assert the narrower invariant: no HOST_UID/HOST_GID build-arg (still correct), while asserting BUN_VERSION/NODE_VERSION build-args ARE present. This is the correct AC4 reading for US-003 (US-003 AC3 explicitly requires the toolchain args to be sourced from the US-001 reader 'by default').

scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings were raised for the 3 touched files (worker-container.ts 278->350, worker-container.test.ts 458->507, ensure-container.test.ts 917->924->925) with a CAM-150 tracker reference prepended to the _ref field, satisfying check:file-size's staged-diff tracker-reference requirement. Gotcha for future stories: the budget line-count uses `content.split('\n').length` (scripts/check-file-sizes.ts), which is ONE MORE than `wc -l` for any file ending in a trailing newline (wc -l counts newline characters, split('\n') produces a trailing empty string). Always cross-check the ceiling against the actual `check:file-size` failure output (which reports the split-based count), not `wc -l`, to avoid an off-by-one retry loop.
nextStoryContext: US-004 (Drop bun-version-conditioned skips; make Ink stdin tests version-agnostic) is next by priority. It touches Ink stdin test infrastructure, not the Docker/toolchain surface US-001..US-003 touched -- read its `notes` field fresh rather than assuming continuity with worker-container.ts. US-005/US-006/US-007 remain queued after it and DO continue the toolchain-parity thread (check:all guard gate, preflight fail-closed assert, auto-rebuild-on-mismatch): those three should read src/config/toolchain.ts's readPinnedBunVersion/readPinnedNodeVersion (added in US-001) and buildDockerBuildArgv's resolveBunVersion/resolveNodeVersion (added in this US-003 commit, bbe5602) as the established seams, rather than re-parsing pin files or re-implementing resolution logic.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Web search corroborated (direct WebFetch to docs.docker.com failed with no output in this sandbox, so WebSearch was used as the fallback path -- recorded per Step 5.5's fetch_failed contingency, but a substitute successful validation was obtained): an ARG declared before the first FROM is scoped only to that FROM line and is NOT visible to any instruction after FROM; it must be re-declared (bare ARG, no value) after FROM to be usable in subsequent RUN steps. This exactly matches the implementation's structure (ARG BUN_VERSION before FROM, consumed only by `FROM oven/bun:${BUN_VERSION}-slim`; ARG NODE_VERSION re-declared immediately after FROM before the Node-install RUN step uses it) and the Dockerfile's own inline comment documenting this gotcha.
